pages.title: Drag it into the email · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday afternoon in an open office in Atlanta. Tom has five tabs open on his computer screen. He needs to send a report to his boss by three o’clock. The report is in the download folder, but he cannot find it. His coworker Priya sits at the next desk. She sees his face and rolls her chair over.
“Hi, Tom! Do you need a hand with the report?” says Priya. “Yes. Can you help me attach this file?” says Tom. “Sure. Put the cursor on the draft, then click Attach.” says Priya.
